mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.parent_id, c.sort_order, c.status, c.recommend, c.image, c.spec_template, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE p.category_id = c.id) AS product_count FROM categories c ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.parent_id, c.sort_order, c.status, c.recommend, c.image, c.spec_template, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products p WHERE p.category_id = c.id) AS product_count FROM categories c WHERE c.id = #{id}

#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (name, parent_id, sort_order, status, recommend, image, spec_template) VALUES (#{name}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{recommend}, #{image}, #{specTemplate})
mapper.update: UPDATE categories SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
